add_task_constructor: add a task constructor to the global manipulation environment registry using registry.add
get_constructor_by_name: get a task constructor by name from the registry using get_constructor
get_all_task_names: get all registered task constructor names using get_all_names
get_tags: get all available tags from the manipulation environment registry using get_tags
get_names_by_tag: get task constructor names filtered by tag using get_names_by_tag
done_importing_tasks: call done_importing_tasks to allow overriding keys for hot-reloading task modules
